text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I feel like I was really able to show
the fruits of my training today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The race wasn't bad at all, and...
I-it gave me a little bit of confidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if I t-try my best,
maybe someday I'll be like the girl running out front...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeh?! D-Did I say that out loud?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm sorry, please forget what I just said!
There's no way someone like me could do it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know!
I gotta face reality more and start with smaller goals...!
choice_data_list: With a run like today's, you can aim even higher!
Let's clear our challenges one by one.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...R-Really?
Do you really truly think so?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm clumsy and always messing up, but...
I-If you say so, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Guh... I-I tripped over my words at the most important part, but I'll keep doing my besttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right!
I can't just stay the way I am now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't have elegance like Opera O-san,
nor analytical skills like Shakur-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Everything else went terribly, too...
I've got so many issues, I can't even count theeeem...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I still have so much to improve on,
but I'll give any training my all, waaaah~~!!
